defensive-bubble.alt: A gold giant spreads its arms as the Defensive Bubble's glowing hexagons shatter around it in a ring of light.

fannys-blades.alt: Fanny smiles in a white corridor with one of her blades glowing bright cyan in front of her.

layla-fanny-team.alt: Chibi Fanny, puzzled, stands beside a scowling Layla with long red twin tails, the two partners of the Layla-Fanny Team.

reunion-on-the-platform.alt: Vexana, her pale hair streaming, cries out and reaches for Guinevere's hand as Guinevere reaches back.
Guinevere stands guard in the smoke while Vexana kneels behind her on the scorched platform, holding her staff.

academy-lawn.alt: Guinevere lies in the sunny grass of the Academy lawn, grinning up, while Vexana's white glove rests on her hair.

monitor-room.alt: Fanny and Layla, seen from behind, watch a wall screen in the monitor room.

vexanas-phone.alt: Vexana's phone glows blue on her desk beside two small dolls, a photo frame and two star charms.
